capabilities: : Create new notes from group headings
: Manage Kanban columns based on groups
extras: The author provides a test vault and build commands for performance checking.
intentEvidence: This is the behaviour asked for in the forum thread Make a note fall into multiple groups.
motivation: The author built it to fulfill a request from a forum thread for notes to fall into multiple groups based on list property values.
problem: Standard Bases views combine notes into a single group based on a list property, making it difficult to view notes separated by each individual list item.
summary: A Bases view that displays notes in separate groups for every unique value found in a list property, rather than combining them into one group.
